words.definition: all the people who work for a company or are available for work
words.example: The company plans to expand its workforce by twenty percent this year.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司計劃今年將員工人數擴大百分之二十。

words.definition: not present at a place where one would usually be, such as work or school
words.example: Please notify your supervisor if you will be absent tomorrow.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你明天要缺席，請通知你的主管。

words.definition: to gradually gather or increase in amount over time
words.example: Employees accumulate paid leave at a rate of one day per month.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工每個月累積一天的有薪假。

words.definition: an assessment of the value or performance of something or someone
words.example: Your annual performance appraisal is scheduled for next Monday.
words.exampleTranslation: 你的年度績效考核安排在下週一。

words.definition: a person learning a trade from a skilled worker
words.example: The apprentice worked under a senior electrician for two years.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位學徒跟著一位資深電工學習了兩年。

words.definition: a man who works in business, especially at a senior level
words.example: The businessman opened his first store downtown twenty years ago.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位商人二十年前在市中心開了第一家店。

words.definition: the inner surface at the top of a room; also used to mean an upper limit
words.example: There is a spending ceiling of five thousand dollars per department.
words.exampleTranslation: 每個部門的支出上限是五千美元。

words.definition: having bright or varied colors
words.example: The new packaging design is more colorful than the old one.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的包裝設計比舊的更加色彩繽紛。

words.definition: to pay someone for loss, damage, or work, or to make up for something
words.example: The airline agreed to compensate passengers for the delayed flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空公司同意就航班延誤補償乘客。

words.definition: a set of clothes worn to represent a particular character or period
words.example: Staff will wear costumes for the store's anniversary event.
words.exampleTranslation: 店員會在店慶活動穿上特別的服裝。

words.definition: relating to the content or opinions published by a newspaper or magazine
words.example: The editorial team decides which stories run on the front page.
words.exampleTranslation: 編輯團隊決定哪些報導要放在頭版。

words.definition: the degree to which something succeeds in producing the desired result
words.example: We measure the effectiveness of each marketing campaign monthly.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們每月衡量每個行銷活動的成效。

words.definition: to make an action or process easier
words.example: The new software facilitates faster communication between departments.
words.exampleTranslation: 這套新軟體讓部門之間的溝通更順暢。

words.definition: a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people
words.example: Firefighters inspected the building after the alarm went off.
words.exampleTranslation: 警報響起後，消防員檢查了整棟大樓。

words.definition: a liquid fuel used mainly in vehicle engines
words.example: Rising gasoline prices have increased our delivery costs.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽油價格上漲增加了我們的配送成本。

words.definition: not suitable or proper for a particular situation
words.example: That comment was inappropriate for a professional meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 那句話在正式會議上並不恰當。

words.definition: the global network that connects computers and allows online communication
words.example: The office internet went down for an hour this morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室的網路今天早上斷線了一個小時。

words.definition: a person who owns a property and rents it out to others
words.example: The landlord agreed to repaint the office before we move in.
words.exampleTranslation: 房東同意在我們搬進去之前重新粉刷辦公室。

words.definition: the way in which the parts of something are arranged or organized
words.example: We're redesigning the warehouse layout to speed up order picking.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們正在重新設計倉庫配置，好加快揀貨速度。

words.definition: the time of day when lunch is usually eaten
words.example: The cafeteria gets crowded around lunchtime.
words.exampleTranslation: 自助餐廳在午餐時間會變得很擁擠。
